params.name: locale
params.description: BCP 47 locale string used for resolving localized experiences. Defaults to "en".

items.docs: Synchronous batch endpoint for upserting events across multiple profiles. Supports up to 200 events total, a maximum of 50 identify events, and up to 50 unique profiles per request. Returns an array of profiles without experiences or changes.
Asynchronous fire-and-forget batch endpoint for importing events. Returns 200 immediately without waiting for processing. Ideal for high-volume imports where response data is not needed.
